notes.title: Sony раскрыла суммарные продажи игр серии Horizon — приключения Элой нашли 38 миллионов покупателей
notes.content: В рамках судебного иска Sony против разработчиков Light of Motiram из Tencent были раскрыты общие продажи игр серии Horizon. К настоящему моменту приключения Элой и её друзей нашли 38 миллионов покупателей — это тираж всех игр с 2017 года.

notes.title: Что будет с эксклюзивами PlayStation? Sony решила выпускать больше игр на Xbox Series X|S и NIntendo Switch 2 — официально
notes.content: Компания Sony Interactive Entertainment разместила вакансию на позицию старшего директора по мультиплатформенной и партнёрской коммерции в подразделении PlayStation Studios. Судя по описанию, PlayStation готовится заметно расширить присутствие своих тайтлов за пределами собственных консолей — включая выпуск игр на ПК, консолях Xbox, Nintendo и мобильных устройствах. Все они прямо фигурируют в официальном объявлении о поиске сотрудника.

notes.title: LEGO начнет сама выпускать игры — без помощи сторонних студий
notes.content: Производитель конструкторов LEGO собираться начать выпускать игры по своей культовой лицензии собственными силами — без помощи сторонних студий. Об этом сообщил генеральный директор компании Нильс Кристианесен в интервью Financial Times.

notes.title: LEGO Horizon Adventures – Patch 1.04
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Patch 1.04 is now available for LEGO Horizon Adventures! Have a look through the Patch Notes listed below, and make sure your game is up-to-date before you jump back in!

[h3]KNOWN ISSUES[/h3]
We’ve heard our community's feedback and appreciate any issues that have 
been flagged to us.  
[list]
[*] Lighting may appear blown out on HDR Steam Deck. To resolve this, either disable HDR or increase the max luminance value to 4500 in the graphics settings.
[*] The game may crash on boot on specific 13th and 14th generation Intel CPUs. To resolve this a BIOS update may be required. [url=https://www.radgametools.com/oodleintel.htm]More information is available here.[/url]
[/list]
[h3]FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
Runs
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could become stuck on a loading screen during the Prologue. Come onnn, we don’t have time, we need to save the world! 
[*] Fixed an issue where loading screen music could play during a cinematic. The loading screen music is great, but that’s for loading... screens. 
[/list]
Mother’s Heart
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the 'Stay Frosty', 'Flaming Ninjas!' and 'Silent Storm' challenges would not progress when defeating element afflicted enemies with a non-elemental weapon. Now you can save your elemental arrows for them pesky Corruptors! 
[*] Fixed an issue where the 'A Brush with Greatness' challenge did not accurately count when changing zone colors. Change alllll the colors! 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Wardrobe could become blocked after the player threw a chicken into it. Why would you even do this, poor chicky. 
[/list]
Characters, Combat & Co-op
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Varl could become stuck in place when catching a Boomerang or Homing Spear. He just got a bit scared; , it happens to us all. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Brick Remover gadget would not destroy Corruption Pools. The Brick Remover had a firmware upgrade.
[*] Fixed an issue where Broadheads could become stuck at the edges of the area. Now they’ll attack you instead! That’s better, right? 
[*] Fixed an issue where the aim indicators for the Spreadshot Bow would disappear for the guest player. Player 2 always has it on hard mode...
[/list]
Other
[list]
[*] Fixed various crashes when pressing ALT+F4 to close the game.
[*] Various bug fixes and stability improvements. 
[*] Various audio fixes and improvements. 
[*] Various text and localization fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Эксклюзивы PlayStation 5 на ПК и других платформах — чего ждать дальше? Sony объяснила мультиплатформенную стратегию
notes.content: В последнее время мультиплатформенная стратегия Sony претерпела изменения — промежутки между релизами крупных одиночных блокбастеров на консолях и ПК сокращаются, некоторые сюжетные игры теперь выходят в Steam одновременно с появлением на PlayStation 5, а LEGO Horizon Adventures вообще выпустили на Nintendo Switch.

notes.title: LEGO Horizon Adventures – Patch 1.03
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Patch 1.03 is available now for LEGO Horizon Adventures! Have a look through the Patch Notes listed below, and make sure your game is up-to-date before you jump back in!

[h3][b]KNOWN ISSUES [/b][/h3]
We’ve heard our community's feedback and are already digging into these pesky issues. They’re not quite fixed in this patch, but rest assured, our teams are on the case and giving them the attention they deserve. Thanks for sticking with us! 

[list]
[*] Nintendo Switch - Players may become stuck on a loading screen during a cinematic transition whilst playing in online co-op.  
[*] The 'Stay Frosty', 'Flaming Ninjas!' and 'Silent Storm' Community Challenges do not progress by defeating element afflicted enemies with a non-elemental weapon. 
[*] Changing environment colors increments the wrong Community Challenge.  
[*] Some machines may spontaneously explode when entering the area (please keep your distance).  
[*] Lighting may appear blown out on HDR Steam Deck. To resolve this either disable HDR, or increase the max luminance value to 4500 in the graphics settings. 
[*] The game may crash on boot on specific 13th and 14th generation Intel CPUs. To resolve this a BIOS update may be required. More information is available here. 
[/list]
[h3][b]FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS [/b][/h3]
Runs 
[list]
[*] The player can get stuck behind a chest in a Forest area. Mimic? Mimic.  
[*] During a Tallneck encounter, there was a chance to become stuck on a rock. The rock has been told to play nicely in future.  
[*] Fixed an issue where combat music would continue to play after completing the objective. It is good music, to be fair. 
[*] Fixed an issue where spike traps would not be highlighted when scanned with the Focus. Pesky spike traps. 
[/list]
Mother’s Heart 
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in local co-op where if one player began building a plot and stopped, the other player would be unable to build the same plot. The plot thickens!  
[*] Fixed an issue where the music in Teb the Tailors shop may not play when unlocked. You can’t have confetti without music!   
[/list]
Characters, Combat & Co-op 
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where if Varl dies whilst having the homing spear equipped, the weapon could lose its ability to lock onto targets and/or be used. Our finest Oseram tinkerers took a look, it should be good now.   
[*] Fixed various issues that would only happen for the guest player during on-line co-op. 
[*] Fixed an issue where Varl may throw the spear the wrong way. This way, Varl!  
[*] Fixed an issue where Snapmaws may be sent flying after being attacked with an elemental weapon. Snapmaw’s blasting off agaaiiiin.  
[*] Fixed an issue where for the guest player, the villagers may not be dancing following completion of a run. They have now equipped their dancing shoes! 
[/list]
Other 
[list]
[*] Various bug fixes and stability improvements.  
[*] Various audio fixes and improvements.  
[*] Various text and localisation fixes. 
[/list]

notes.title: Квадратные щечки счастья: Обзор LEGO Horizon Adventures
notes.content: В последние пару лет в игровом подразделении Sony складывается довольно странная ситуация. Описать ее приблизительно можно фразой «Electronic Arts под пятой DICE».

notes.title: LEGO Horizon Adventures – Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Patch 1.02 is available now for LEGO Horizon Adventures! Have a look through the Patch Notes listed below, and make sure your game is up-to-date before you jump back in!

[h3][b]KNOWN ISSUES [/b][/h3]
We’ve heard our community's feedback and are already digging into these pesky issues. They’re not quite fixed in this patch, but rest assured, our teams are on the case and giving them the attention they deserve. Thanks for sticking with us! 
[list]
[*] The 'Stay Frosty', 'Flaming Ninjas!' and 'Silent Storm' Community Challenges do not progress by defeating element afflicted enemies with a non-elemental weapon. 
[*] Changing environment colors increments the wrong Community Challenge.  
[*] Some machines may spontaneously explode when entering the area (please keep your distance). 
[*] Lighting may appear blown out on HDR Steamdeck. To resolve this either disable HDR, or increase the max luminance value to 4500 in the graphics settings. 
[*] The game may crash on boot on specific 13th and 14th generation Intel CPUs. To resolve this a BIOS update may be required. [url=https://www.radgametools.com/oodleintel.htm]More information is available here.[/url] 
[/list]
[b]NEW FEATURES [/b]
[list]
[*] Added a Player Progression screen to track content / overall game progress. 
[*] Options have been added to allow you to customize which features are highlighted when using the Focus. Highlight ALL THE THINGS. 
[/list]
[h3][b]FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS [/b][/h3]
Runs 
[list]
[*] Various fixes to reduce the risk of the player getting stuck outside of the level. 
[*] Performed a balancing pass on various Apex Hunts.  
[*] Fixed the player having a chance of being eaten by (stuck inside) the Dragon Cart masterbuilding object when it has been built.  
[/list]
Mother’s Heart 
[list]
[*] Added stud rewards when having interacted with various yard customization plots. 
[*] The fish from the Fishing Pond can now be eaten by animals (sorry fish). 
[/list]
Characters & Co-op 
[list]
[*] Improved the visibility of player rings when playing in co-op.  
[*] Improved Teersa’s ability to defend herself against projectiles. This old gal’s still got it! 
[*] Improved the responsiveness of Teersa’s hold attack ability. Seriously, don’t mess with Teersa... 
[*] Fixed an issue where the guest player may be missing a pickup prompt on gadgets and weapons after dying and being revived.  
[*] Fixed an issue where the Deathbringer may always target the host player and not the guest. No playing favorites! 
[/list]
UI/UX 
[list]
[*] Added a note to indicate which player opened the Pause Menu. 
[*] Various localization improvements.  
[*] Fixed an issue where simultaneously pressing the Cross and OPTIONS buttons may cause the Pause Menu to become unresponsive. There’s no trophy for button mashing! 
[*] Removed a ‘Continue’ button that does not function on various Brick screens.  
[*] Improved the HUD Scale option to increase the size of the quest markers, damage numbers, danger warnings, and more! 
[*] Added ‘+’ signs to upgrade stickers to better highlight stat increases.  
[/list]
Combat 
[list]
[*] PC Only - Fixed an issue where the player can lose functionality by pausing and clicking off the game window when charging the Arrow Storm Bow.  Stay focused Aloy! 
[*] Ensured that Erend’s stacked Giant Hammer now deals increased damage to the Deathbringer. Don’t stop him now! 
[*] Fixed an issue where machines may become stuck on geometry. Math is hard. 
[/list]
Other 
[list]
[*] PC Only - Adjusted default graphics settings based on hardware.  
[*] PC Only – Improved performance on Intel ARC series GPUs. 
[*] Various bug fixes and stability improvements.  
[*] Various audio fixes and improvements.  
[*] Significantly improved stability of reflections and facial animations on Nintendo Switch. 
[/list]

notes.title: LEGO Horizon Adventures is out now!
notes.content:
The wait is over – it’s finally time to join Aloy and her friends in LEGO Horizon Adventures! 

We’re excited to celebrate the launch of LEGO Horizon Adventures, co-developed by the incredible teams here at Guerrilla, Studio Gobo and the LEGO Group. Check out our new launch trailer – a sneak peek into this lighthearted, fun-filled adventure where everything in the world of Horizon is made of LEGO bricks, from the towering Tallneck to the smallest details in Mother’s Heart.

[previewyoutube=RYjc6mfBvB4;full][/previewyoutube]  

Whether you’re a long-time Horizon fan or new to the world, LEGO Horizon Adventures has something special for everyone. You don’t need to be familiar with the Horizon universe to jump in, but longtime fans will spot a few Easter eggs and references along the way.

You can play alone or grab a friend or family member and join Aloy’s journey together. We wanted this to be a truly collaborative experience, giving players of all ages and skill levels the chance to enjoy the adventure, build connections, and share a love for LEGO bricks and Horizon. The world is packed with machines, with each battle offering its own fun twist on Horizon’s combat. The difficulty is scalable, so whether you’re in Story Mode for a relaxing experience or looking for a challenge on Very Hard mode, there’s something for everyone. And there’s so much more to explore. Build, customize, and upgrade your character – or head to Mother’s Heart, where you can modify the village to reflect your own unique style.

On behalf of the teams at Guerrilla, Studio Gobo and The LEGO Group, we want to say a huge thank you to our amazing community. Your enthusiasm and passion for Horizon have inspired every moment of LEGO Horizon Adventures, and we’re thrilled to bring you this playful new take on Aloy’s world. We can’t wait to hear what you think. 

To learn even more about the game, please visit www.legohorizonadventures.com and make sure to follow Guerrilla on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube for all the latest news and updates about Horizon. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428810/LEGO_Horizon_Adventures/

notes.title: LEGO Horizon Adventures (PS5) Review
notes.content:
I admit, when LEGO Horizon Adventures was announced earlier this year, I wasn’t sure where it was coming from or who it was for. The franchise didn’t strike me as the sort of lighthearted, “blockbuster movie” fare that most LEGO games draw from. The kooky tone of the original trailer looked so far removed from the vision I’d gleaned from a distance. Sure, there was that one LEGO set, but what else did these two things have to do with each other?

Since that announcement, we’ve heard how much the team at Guerilla Games adores LEGO (even prototyping the earliest pre-production robots out of Duplo), and now, having actually put this unlikely spin-off through its paces, I get it.

LEGO Horizon Adventures reimagines Horizon Zero Dawn in full, glorious toy form. Players follow the legendary hunter Aloy from her humble origins, her story recounted in the LEGO games’ “slightly bending the fourth wall” style; Teersa, Varl, and... Read more

notes.title: LEGO Horizon Adventures launches November 14, Pre-orders available now!
notes.content:
We are ecstatic to announce that LEGO Horizon Adventures is releasing on November 14 2024! It’s been incredible to see everyone’s reactions to everything we’ve shown so far, as well as the creativity it has inspired with LEGO builders and fan artists alike.    

Pre-orders for the game are available now, so please scroll down for more information regarding the available editions and enjoy our celebratory new trailer!  
  
[previewyoutube=ovqil6gQq10;full][/previewyoutube]  

If you pre-order any physical edition from participating retailers or any digital edition on your preferred platform, you will receive a LEGO version of the iconic Shield-Weaver outfit to use in the game.   

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065445/e3d525d5512a3426301bdd70878c1934f59b7a31.jpg[/img]

The Digital Deluxe Edition comes with several exciting bonuses:  

[list]
[*] [b]Roller Coaster Customization[/b] | No need to choose between roof or coaster; you can have both and bring some theme park fun to Mother’s Heart!  
[*] [b]Three iconic Horizon outfits[/b] | Pay homage to Aloy’s adventures in the icy north with the Banuk Armor, channel your inner Eclipse with the Shadow Stalwart outfit, or fight metal with metal as “Alloy” Aloy!  
[*] [b]Ratchet and Rivet outfits[/b] | Join the thrilling journey as intergalactic super-mechanic Ratchet or trans-dimensional Resistance fighter Rivet.  
[*] [b]Sackboy outfit[/b] | Trading cloth and stuffing for bricks and studs, LittleBigPlanet's Sackboy is available to join the party!  
[/list]
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065445/3ec7c62b203f7ad2011d67522b16106c940e481a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065445/db76fa53403e08eee0b43d8fd0023cab70017509.jpg[/img]  

A Standard Edition is also available in both digital and physical formats. Experience Aloy's entire thrilling journey, endless co-op fun, and a stunningly reimagined universe filled with dinosaur-like robots in LEGO Horizon Adventures!     

LEGO Horizon Adventures launches on PlayStation 5, PC, and Nintendo on 14 November 2024, with pre-orders live October 3. Pre-ordering the game can be done on the platform of your choosing; find it on the PlayStation Store, Steam, Epic Game Store, and the Nintendo eShop.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428810/LEGO_Horizon_Adventures/  

From all of us at Guerrilla and Studio Gobo, thank you for your enthusiasm and support for LEGO Horizon Adventures! To learn more about the game, please visit [url=http://www.legohorizonadventures.com/]www.legohorizonadventures.com[/url].
